definitions.gloss: solidarity; unity; standing united; pulling together
definitions.explanation: A group coming together with a shared purpose and acting as one. A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) emphasizing collective resolve and cooperation.

examples.japanese: {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}ろう→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: Let's unite and do our best.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかんだ。
examples.english: The team pulled together and seized victory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}した→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧とき、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: When facing a crisis, all the employees united and overcame it.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) combining ⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧ (agreement, unity) and ⟦{団結|だんけつ}→団結：15725_danketsu⟧ (solidarity, unity). Emphasizes a group acting with one mind and purpose.

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ as an adverb: {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ (in unity, with solidarity). Common in speeches, team contexts, and situations calling for collective action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle something together
- {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧: to fight together as one
- {一致団結|いっちだんけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: the spirit of solidarity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一丸|いちがん}→一丸：28278_ichigan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become one, to unite (similar meaning, also very common)
- ⟦{結束|けっそく}→結束：13799_kessoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to band together — more general
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}する→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧: to cooperate — less emphatic about unity of purpose
